title: The first write makes the storage folder
summary: The firmware's files host makes the folder /odrig of the board's storage once, inside write_open, when a write finds it missing: one mkdir after a failed open, then the open again. A board that was only ever flashed, never given a show by install-show, has no such folder, since WLED formats a fresh root without it and the file system makes no folder for a file, so its first upload from the phone was refused with storage-error at upload begin. A storage with the folder pays nothing, a refused mkdir ends in -1 as today, the start still writes nothing, and every file the core writes gets the folder. Firmware only, no new command, the core and the app unchanged; on pull request #50's branch, seed 77's, as further task commits, with the two pull-request images and the spare's combined image with seed 76's branch delivered on the Drive.
